Definition
[Convex hyperbolic manifold] 1. Definition 8.3.1\group convex hyperbolic manifoldsSource: thurston:page-0192 A complete hyperbolic manifold with boundary is convex if every path is homotopic rel endpoints to a geodesic arc.
